figures.title: Exact versus estimated harmonic free energy

rendering_config.left_panel: exact reference and FEP error bars

scientific_limitations: The model is a three-dimensional harmonic oscillator, not a protein-ligand system.
Only forward FEP is shown; no bidirectional estimator or MBAR overlap correction is applied.
Finite-sample bias under poor overlap can remain even when the standard error is small.
Effective sample size is an observed-weight diagnostic, not proof of complete phase-space coverage.
No imatinib binding free energy is computed.
figures.alt_text: Two panels showing exact and FEP harmonic free-energy convergence with error bars and effective sample fractions.
figures.caption: Controlled three-dimensional harmonic model. Dashed lines are the exact free-energy differences; points are forward-FEP estimates with standard errors as sample count grows. The right panel shows effective sample fraction for the good- and poor-overlap cases.
